articles.title: Meta introduces Muse Wonder, its next chapter in AI agents
articles.summary: Meta has introduced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full for personal and professional agent tasks. Its performance claims come from the company and should be weighed against independent evaluations.

articles.title: China moves to tighten technology exports, including AI
articles.summary: AP reports that China is moving to restrict exports of sensitive technologies, including artificial intelligence, citing national security concerns.

articles.title: Nvidia’s Huang sees a future for agents in robotics
articles.summary: At a London event, Jensen Huang discussed the potential of AI agents in robotics and research while calling for controls around their use.

articles.title: A new paper examines AI-generated mathematical ideas
articles.summary: A preprint explores mathematical instruments drawn from OpenAI’s October release of AI-generated mathematics. Treat this as emerging research rather than a settled scientific result.

articles.title: Reading list: how agentic coding is changing development
articles.summary: Anthropic’s 2026 report examines how coding agents are reshaping software work. This background reading provides context for the daily news cycle.

articles.title: Muse expands its focus to small businesses
articles.summary: Meta is positioning Muse as an assistant for small-business operations, extending its agent ambitions beyond individual consumers.
